articleTitle: Comments on "An Efficient and Provably Secure Authenticated Key Agreement Protocol for Fog-Based Vehicular Ad-Hoc Networks"
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Vehicle ad-hoc networks (VANETs) have experienced rapid growth due to the advancement of cloud computing, IoT technologies, and intelligent transportation systems (ITS). Vehicles are required to have enhanced storage capacity, onboard computing capabilities, improved sensing power, and communication systems. To address real-world demands like low latency, affordable storage, and mobility in VANET deployments, There have been efforts to integrate fog computing with VANETs in a practical implementation. "An Efficient and Provably Secure Authenticated Key Agreement Protocol for Fog-Based Vehicular Ad-Hoc Networks" was proposed by Ma et al. (IEEE Internet of Things Journal, pp 8065–8075, 10.1109/JIOT.2019.2902840). According to their claims, the use of their secure authentication technique can help prevent security threats. However, after careful investigation, we discovered that their authentication protocol is susceptible to vehicle user impersonation attacks and also does not provide vehicle anonymity. In light of this, we have provided some recommendations to address the current flaws in the protocol developed by Ma et al.

articleTitle: Optimal Relay Placement for Relay-assisted Underwater Wireless Optical Communication Systems over Weak Turbulence Channel
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: In this paper, based on the principle of optimal performance, we investigate relay placement in a relay-assisted underwater wireless optical communication (UWOC) system with a single relay over a log-normal turbulence channel. To evaluate the system performance, outage probability is deduced where the system adopts a decode-and-forward (DF) relay, and the effect of depth on solar noise is considered. Then, a two-dimensional Cartesian coordinate system is established to describe the optimization model. Due to the non-convex objective function, it cannot be solved directly using convex optimization methods. Hence, we consider an alternating iteration method to iteratively solve the relay’s position and obtain a suboptimal solution. Through simulations, the proposed solution method is verified to be able to obtain the optimal position, and the UWOC system using optimal relay placement (ORP) has a significantly better performance.

articleTitle: TDOA and FDOA Joint Estimation Method for Communication Radiation Sources Based on Generalized Extended Approximation Method and Semi-definite Programming
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low accuracy in estimating the time difference of arrival (TDOA) and frequency difference of arrival (FDOA) of communication radiation source signals directly using the cross-ambiguity function method in the passive positioning of communication radiation sources, this paper presents a method of communication radiation source time-frequency difference estimation combined with the generalized extended approximation (GEA) method and the semi-definite programming (SDP) algorithm. The complex baseband signal after detection of communication radiation source signal is processed by cross-ambiguity function, and the programming function is established by generalized extended approximation model. Finally, the programming function is transformed into a semi-definite model to solve the function parameters. The real point of the surface obtained is the high-precision joint estimation result of TDOA and FDOA. The simulation results show that this method can improve the estimation accuracy of TDOA and FDOA, and improve the solving efficiency of TDOA and FDOA.

articleTitle: Resistive Switching of RF Sputtered Tin-dioxide (SnO2) Based Memristor for Non-volatile Memory
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Memristor taking advantages of the reversible resistive switching (RS) behavior to store information shows great potential in future computing-in-memory and thus has attracted great attention. In this study, we proposed a Cu/SnO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/ITO structure based memristor which shows a typical bipolar resistive switching behavior. The resistive switching performances and mechanisms of SnO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> memristor were systematically studied. 20 cycles of obvious memory window and small operating voltage of 0.9 V render it suitable for non-volatile memory. Electrochemical metallization (ECM) mechanism is found to be suitable for understanding the current conduction which shows an obvious formation and rupture of conductive filament.

articleTitle: Reliable Fusion and Confidence Evaluation for RGBT Tracking
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: The decisive factor of RGBT object tracking is that how to properly evaluate the contribution to tracking results and optimally utilize the complementary information of visible and thermal modalities. This paper proposes an robust RGBT tracking method based on reliable modality fusion and tracking confidence evaluation. An adaptive fusion scheme of response maps, which are obtained by those designed trackers, is introduced to measure contribution of each modality to the tracking result. Furthermore, the confidence evaluation of tracking result is proceed to monitor the tracking state and promote the online learning of trackers. The updating strategy of sample space and the directional relocation are introduced to improve the the stability of target tracking. Simulation shows that the proposed method, which obtains 70.8% in precision rate and 50.5% in success rate on the RGBT 234 datasets, effectively reduces the negative influence of low-quality samples and recaptured the lost target especially in those challenging scenes, such as partial occlusion, low illumination, camera movement and background occlusion.

articleTitle: Research of Crowd Density Estimation Algorithm Based on CAN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Population estimation refers to the use of various methods and tools to estimate the number of people in a specific area or location, which has broad significance in multiple fields. It helps to better understand population behavior, make wise decisions, and prevent emergency situations. This article introduces a crowd density estimation algorithm based on an improved Context AwareNet (CAN). Using the classic vgg-16 network structure and the ShanghaiTech dataset, the function of estimating the number of people in the target image is achieved. After the training and testing of the network model, it is found that the effect of void convolution is not as good as that of ordinary convolution, and the model has serious errors for low-density test images. By optimizing the parameters, improving the network structure, and modifying the data set, two crowd density estimation models for different types of people are generated. By combining the two models, the identification accuracy of low density people is improved and the generalization ability of the algorithm is enhanced without affecting the accuracy rate of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Delay Analysis and Testing of TAS Mechanism in Time-Sensitive Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Time-Aware Shaper(TAS), as an vitally important synchronous scheduling mechanism in Time-Sensitive Networks(TSN), is defined by the IEEE 802.1 Qbv [1] standard. TAS achieves non-waiting transmission of Time-Triggered(TT) streams by using Gate Control List(GCL). This paper analyzes the end-to-end(E2E) latency of time-sensitive flows when using the TAS mechanism. We built a testing platform using TSN switches and a professional tester. In the presence of background flows, we changed some key parameters and conducted multiple sets of tests. The test results indicate that when the TAS mechanism takes effect, it can achieve bounded latency for high priority traffic. In addition, ensuring the match between the arrival of high priority traffic and the GCL is a prerequisite for the high-performance operation of TAS.

articleTitle: Research on Water and Rain Conditions System Based on NB IoT Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Water and rain monitoring is an important basis for scientific management, development and utilization of water conservancy projects, as well as an important means of water resource protection and reducing and preventing losses from flood disasters. In order to meet the real-time, effective, and reliable requirements of water and rain data collection by water administrative departments, a water level and rain real-time monitoring system based on NB IoT technology is proposed. The system is based on NB IoT communication technology and develops a telemetry module based on the BC95 module. It then collects data from water level sensors and rainfall sensors, and transmits these data to the hydrological management center through NB IoT communication to achieve real-time monitoring of water level and rainfall data information. The results indicate that NB IoT technology has the advantages of strong penetration ability, low power consumption, stable operation, and high reliability in water and rain monitoring, and can be applied to practical hydrological telemetry systems.

articleTitle: Improved Generalized Cross Correlation Communication Radiation Source Time Difference Estimation Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: The aim is to address the issue of low accuracy in traditional cross correlation estimation methods of time difference of arrival (TDOA) under low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) conditions, this paper proposes a generalized cross correlation (GCC) method for estimating arrival time difference estimation method based on variational modal decomposition (VMD) and wavelet denoising. Firstly, VMD is used to decompose the communication signal in each symbol period, and several intrinsic mode functions ( IMFs ) are obtained. Secondly, using the sample entropy and correlation coefficient of these IMF components as a basis, distinguishing the signal components and the main noise components. Then, the noise components are denoised by the wavelet threshold method, moreover, the processed noise components and the signal components are reconstructed to get the noise-canceled signal. Finally, the GCC is used to get the time delay estimate of the two reconstructed signals. It can be concluded from the simulation that when the SNR of this method is −10dB, the root mean square error (RMSE) of the proposed method is reduced by about 37% in comparison with the traditional algorithms.

articleTitle: Smart Substation Alarm Analysis Method Based on Semantic Rules Extraction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: The alarm information generated by the security equipment of smart substation presents the characteristics of isolation, fragmentation and redundancy, which makes it a big problem to analyze the alarm information and make the corresponding disposal means. This paper proposes a smart substation alarm analysis method based on semantic rule extraction, which applies threat intelligence to smart substation threat detection. Firstly, a semantic rule model is constructed to define the attributes, relationships and semantic rules of network entities. Then, a semantic rule extraction framework is constructed to extract semantic rules from ATT&CK model attack technical texts. Finally, it matches with the alarm log data of smart substation to realize the association of alarm information and restore the attack context.

articleTitle: Research on Clothing Style Recognition and Recommendation System based on Improved YOLOv3
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Clothing style recognition is an important application of computer vision in recent years. With the rapid development of deep learning technology, image retrieval technology based on convolutional neural networks has made significant breakthroughs in the field of clothing. With the increase in the number and variety of clothing, people need to spend more time selecting suitable clothing products, and a good recommendation system is particularly important. Firstly, in order to fully explore the multi-scale features of clothing images from global to local, and make the model pay more attention to the clothing itself, a multi-scale clothing image landmark area positioning algorithm based on YOLOv3 was proposed, which can extract global features, main features and local features more accurately. Next, in order to make clothing image retrieval truly focus on the retrieved clothing and accurately extract clothing style features, the Delete Common Features (DCF) algorithm and Combine Feature Descriptors (CFD) algorithm were applied to different network convolutional layers. Finally, a clothing style feature extraction model (MCSF) based on multi-scale convolutional neural networks was proposed to achieve accurate clothing style recommendation. The experimental results show that the proposed model has higher accuracy and accuracy compared to other network models.

articleTitle: Intelligent Communication Resource Allocation for UAV Emergency Communications Using Multi-agent Soft Actor-Critic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) are widely utilized to establish emergency communications, where the UAVs work as temporary base stations and the limited communication resource should be utilized efficiently. In this paper, we study how to maximize the utilization efficiency of spectrum and power based on the Multi-agent Soft Actor-Critic (MASAC) algorithm. In the proposed scheme, the centralized training with decentralized execution (CTDE) framework is used to achieve intelligent communication resource allocation for UAV emergency communications. The simulation results and theoretical analysis indicate that the CTDE framework can achieve better performance compared with the fully distributed (FD) framework and the MASAC algorithm outperforms the traditional Deep Q Network (DQN) algorithm.

articleTitle: Optimal Radio Labeling for Strong Product Graph of Star Graph and Path
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: For the increasingly scarce frequency resources in wireless communication networks, topology diagrams are usually used to model the communication network, and the radio labelings of vertices in the graph are studied through "frequency -distance" constraints to simulate the allocation of frequency resources in the wireless communication network. This paper mainly studies the strong product graph of 4-order star graph and n-order path ( n≥3 ), labels its vertices based on relevant constraints, and provides the lower bound of radio labelings for this network structure, as well as the optimal radio labeling allocation scheme.

articleTitle: Analysis of LED Layout in Visible Light Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Visible light communication has received widespread attention in recent years, and the design and optimization of visible light communication systems require further exploration. This paper analyzes the research significance of visible light communication, introduces the basic model of indoor visible Photosystem, introduces the three important components of the model, namely LED light source, propagation channel and receiver, and then elaborates the basic concepts and calculation ideas of the system's illuminance, signal-to-noise ratio, time extension. And pointed out the direction for further research.

articleTitle: A 16B 5MS/s Pipeline-SAR ADC in 180nm CMOS
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: This paper presents the design and simulation of a 16-bit pipeline-SAR Analog-to-Digital Converter (ADC) using a "6+10" architecture. The design aims to alleviate residue amplifier pressure by employing dynamic and static amplifiers in the first and second stages, respectively. The residue amplifier design incorporates folding interpolation and auxiliary amplifier sharing to enhance gain accuracy. Auto-zeroing mitigates flicker noise influence. The design employs the SMIC 180nm CMOS process. At 250 kS/s, the circuit achieves 16.1-bit ENOB and 98 dB SNR. At 1 MS/s, it attains 16.5-bit ENOB and 101 dB SNR. Results showcase robust performance and confirm efficacy for high-precision analog-to-digital conversion. Power consumption is 55 mW in simulation.

articleTitle: Dynamic Modulation Transmission Policy for Wireless Communication Network with Energy Harvesting
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: This paper considers an IoT communication network based on an energy-harvesting (EH) node that harvests energy from the ambiance using buffers with the harvest-store-use (HSU) architecture. To better ensure communication quality and utilize energy more efficiently, we propose a dynamic modulation strategy to select appropriate modulation methods based on channel power and energy stored in the buffer. An algorithm based on the state transition matrix (STM) is proposed to obtain the probability distribution of the stored energy in the buffer. Numerous experiments have been performed to obtain the network outage probability and throughput.

articleTitle: Few-Shot Classification Algorithm for Space Targets Based on High Order Statistical Features and Meta Attention
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: The rapid advancements in space exploration technology have led to a multitude of space targets, resulting in challenges for surveillance and awareness. However, obtaining data on these space targets remains a challenging and costly endeavor due to limitations in observation. Dependence solely on big data in traditional deep learning methods falls short of producing desired outcomes. Few-Shot Learning aims to train models using a limited number of examples to solve problems, reducing the reliance on extensive data sets. This study proposes a Metric-Learning-based Meta-Learning approach for Few-Shot Classification. The objective is to learn suitable image features for similarity measurement, introducing statistical features such as covariance and coskewness to determine correlations among different image categories. Additionally, a Meta-Attention mechanism has been designed to minimize the impact of cluttered backgrounds on classification results, based on Meta-Learning characteristics. These components are developed as pluggable Higher-Order Moment modules and highly portable Attention layers. This study proposes BCANET, a Few-Shot Classification network based on these modules, achieving state-of-the-art performance on the Mini-ImageNet dataset with a classification accuracy of 92.41%. And achieved an accuracy of 92.29% on the spatial target dataset

articleTitle: Optimization of Satellite Onboard Information Flow Based on CANFD Data Bus
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: CANFD data bus is introduced in this paper to optimize satellite onboard information flow, including telemetry, telecontrol, time synchronization, high speed upload data distribution and other self-defined in-orbit processing flow. Uniform frame format is defined in this paper to simplify onboard software complexity.

articleTitle: An Uplink Access Scheme for Cell-Free MIMO System with Channel Aging
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: The mismatches between the estimated channels and real channels caused by channel aging will increase significantly over time in cell-free multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO), and user mobility exacerbates this variation. In this paper, we investigate the impact of user-access point (UE-AP) matching strategies in mobile communications on the performance of cell-free MIMO systems affected by channel aging. First, we construct a real-time channel estimation scheme, which combines CSI with real-time environmental feedback to alleviate the effects of channel aging caused by Doppler drift on system performance. The application of the MMSE estimator under channel aging is also rederived. Then we propose a user-centric, energy-efficient dynamic UE-AP allocation scheme to adapt to the dynamic propagation environment. Simulation results show that the scheme we propose can improve the energy utilization significantly, thereby achieving the goal of green communication, and outperforms other alternatives in terms of resource utilization, without compromising communication quality.

articleTitle: Data Collection Platform Construction Technology in the Context of Digital Transformation of Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: With the development of big data, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, Internet of Things, blockchain and other technologies, digitalization is directly driving the transformation of socio-economic development. The digital transformation of higher education, as a key area for achieving sustainable development, has become an important trend in future educational reform and development. Digital transformation of education is a systematic change of technology-enabled education, which is a continuous evolutionary process with strong complexity and dynamics. The establishment of an education digitalization framework or maturity model is an important groundwork for digital transformation of education. It will provide a clear strategy and path for the digital transformation of education and the construction of "digital campus", and promote the sustainability of the practice. Therefore, this paper explores the technology of data collection platform construction in the digital transformation of higher education based on light applications and APPs, so as to provide more references for further enriching the education digitalization framework and related models.

articleTitle: A Traffic Sign Detection Network based on Dynamic Focusing Loss and Lightweight Convolution
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: The booming development of unmanned technology has placed greater demands on traffic sign detection. In this context, speed and accuracy are simultaneously pursued, yet existing detection techniques often struggle with challenges such as small targets and complex backgrounds, particularly in real-time scenarios. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a new traffic sign detection model based on YOLOv8s with the following improvements. A Faster Neural Next Work (FasterNeXt) layer is used for small target feature extraction, which enhances the feature extraction capability of the network for small targets while guaranteeing lightweight. A lightweight global sparse convolution (GSConv) is used, which reduces the weight of the model and improves the generalization performance of the model. The optimization of low-quality labels in traffic sign detection using Wise-IOU version 3 (WIoUv3) significantly enhances detection accuracy. Tests on the CCTSDB2021 dataset and the TT100K show that our method performs better with fewer parameters than existing algorithms. The accuracy of our model in traffic sign detection improves by 1% to reach 98%, the Frames Per Second (FPS) increases by 3.37, and there is a reduction in the number of parameters. Our model can satisfy the requirements of assisting vehicle driving.

articleTitle: The Impact of UAV Jittering at Different Altitudes on Air-to-Ground Wireless Channel
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: In recent years, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) have attracted attention in civil and military scenarios with advantages such as low cost and easy deployment. However, in the actual communication process, the aerial drone platform does not have fixed infrastructure support, and is significantly affected by the airflow, mechanical vibration of the body and other factors that affect the stability of UAV. This will also affect the air-to-ground (A2G) wireless channels. At present, most of the researches on UAV communication channel do not consider the impact of the jittering characteristics of the UAV platform. In this paper, we present a study of the influence of UAV jitter when hovering at different altitudes at 2.4 GHz band on the received signal, and on A2G wireless channels under different propagation scenarios. The results show that in the line of sight (LoS) scenario, the stability of the drone hovering has a greater effect on the signal than its influence in the non-line of sight (NLoS) scenario.

articleTitle: Auto-Scaling Service Strategy for Distributed Satellite System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: In this paper, we investigate a scenario where a distributed satellite system (DSS) serves as a distributed computing platform within the space-terrestrial integrated network (STIN), catering to ground users. To enhance the scalability of the distributed computing system and adapt to variations in user request traffic, we propose an auto-scaling service strategy based on traffic prediction. The prediction is implemented using the long short-term memory recurrent neural network (LSTM-RNN) method. Numerical results are presented to demonstrate the superiority of our proposed traffic prediction algorithm compared to existing approaches, while experimental findings confirm that our auto-scaling service strategy effectively enhances system performance in terms of service quality.

articleTitle: An Intelligent WSN-Based Digital Twin Design for Photovoltaic Power Generation Forecast
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Photovoltaic power generation has been extensively utilized for power supply in remote areas. Due to the effect of weather and environmental conditions, its power generation experiences fluctuations. This paper proposes a dedicated WSN-based digital twin design for photovoltaic power generation. In this design, WSN is used to regularly collect and transmit monitoring data. The cloud platform and neural network are then integrated to displays equipment's status and predict power generation. Experimental results demonstrate that this digital twin design can effectively display the real-time operating status and environmental information. Using the LSTM-CNN algorithm achieve an accurate power prediction, with the RMSE and MAE values of 0.436 and 0.209 respectively. The real-time status monitoring and power prediction of photovoltaic equipment can not only provide a basis for fault diagnosis, but also optimize power grid dispatch in remote areas.

articleTitle: 3D CD-LinkNet with Cascaded Dilated Convolution for Liver Vessel Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Automatic segmentation of liver blood vessels from CT images is very helpful for clinical surgery. Due to the small volume, variable shape and low contrast of CT images, it is difficult to segment blood vessels in abdominal CT images. To address these issues, this paper attempted to segment liver blood vessels in three steps. The first step is pre-processing to improve the contrast of the CT images. The second step is to segment liver blood vessels through a newly proposed 3D segmentation network with dilated convolutions. The third step is to perform post-processing on the segmentation results. Segmenting liver blood vessels in 3D views may result in better segmentation results due to the increased volume of blood vessels. Dilated convolutions are cascaded to extract features from a wider field of view, thereby solving the issue of small volume and variable shape. This method has been tested on a public dataset 3Dircadb-01 and compared with several existing methods. Experimental results show, the proposed method achieved the highest segmentation accuracy, with Dice score 0.6596. The method proposed in this paper is limited to blood vessel segmentation in the liver region and can be used in conjunction with appropriate liver segmentation methods.

articleTitle: A Study on Radio Propagation Channel Modeling for Low Altitude UAV
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Air-ground (AG) communication is a fundamental technology for integration of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) in the intelligent transportation system, the analysis and modeling of the propagation characteristics of AG wireless channel provide essential foundations for the design, optimization and performance evaluation of AG communication systems. To investigate the radio propagation channel modeling for low altitude UAV, this paper presents a narrowband channel measurement campaign on the campus environment at 2.4 GHz, and then the large- and small-scale channel model for the AG scenarios are established. Based on the measurement data, the channel parameters are extracted. The Log-distance path loss model is given herein, then shadow fading, small-scale fading channel characteristics are statistically analyzed for comprehensively describing the fading behavior. The second-order statistic parameters level crossing rate (LCR) and average fade duration (AFD) of propagation channel are analyzed. Our results will be useful in the modeling of AG channels and the performance analysis for UAV-enabled wireless communication systems.

articleTitle: A Robust Digital Audio Watermarking Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of insufficient embedding strength and single attack mode, this paper proposes a robust digital audio watermarking algorithm for binary images. The watermark encryption, embedding, attack, extraction and decryption are completed. The watermark image is encrypted by Arnold transform, the feature sequence is extracted by wavelet transform, and Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) and Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) are performed. Finally, the watermark image is embedded into the audio signal. Watermark extraction is the reverse operation of watermark embedding. Arnold inverse transform is applied to the extracted watermark to obtain the decrypted watermark image. Low-pass filtering, random noise, cropped audio, and resampling are used for the attacks. Normalized Correlation coefficient (NC), Symbol Error Rate (SER), Pearson Correlation Coefficients (PCCs), and Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) are used for objective evaluation. Experiment results show the proposed algorithm has better robustness and invisibility, which is favorable for the privacy protection of audio information.

articleTitle: A Robust Image Watermark Algorithm Based on Double Encryption
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Most of the current image watermarking algorithms focus on robustness and imperceptibility, while few research targeting security. This paper combines digital watermarking with cryptography, and proposes an image encryption algorithm combined Memristive Chaotic Cellular Neural Networks (MCCNN) and Arnold transformation. The MCCNN is used to generate multiple and diverse chaotic sequences to improve the security of the watermark image, and the two-dimensional discrete wavelet transform (DWT) is adopted to embed the watermark according to the embedding intensity value. The experiment results show the effectiveness of the proposed image watermarking algorithm based on double encryption, which is robust to common attacks such as image rotation, noise addition, and JPEG compression.

articleTitle: PI Control With Coefficient Revised by Random Parameter Applied in Wavefront Correction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: The stability of wireless optical communication systems is severely affected by the presence of atmospheric turbulence and other interference factors. Reducing the interference of these factors by adaptive optical correction techniques is an important method to ensure the stable operation of wireless optical communication systems. The study analyzes the influence of fixed-proportional link parameters and random-proportional parameters on the system control in different turbulent environments by using two method: 1) Zernike polynomial simulation of the atmospheric turbulence aberrant phase and first 32-order Zernike coefficients data collected by the Hardman wavefront sensor and 2) consideration of the corrected PV value of the wavefront and PV value formed by the deformation mirror agitation as the main assessment indexes. The results show that the turbulent phase PV values obtained after PI control using the stochastic atmospheric turbulence parameter are better than those obtained when controlled by fixed integral coefficients, in both weak and strong turbulence environments.

articleTitle: Design on Integrated Space-ground Video and Audio Communication Network of Manned Spacecraft
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Video and audio communications between space and ground play an important role in manned space flight. In order to realize video and audio communications between space and ground, an integrated space-ground video and audio communications network is proposed in this paper according to the characteristics of communications link between manned spacecraft and ground station, such as the long delay and the asymmetry of forward and backward link rate. Transmission of video and audio data between space and ground is achieved by IP over CCSDS technology. For different types and priorities of data, a scheduling method combining static priority and polling scheduling strategy is adopted to ensure business transmission requirements. Channel encoding, scrambling, and synchronization words is adopted to ensure the quality of service of video and audio transmission between space and ground. The proposed space-ground video and audio communications network has been verified by both ground test and in-orbit test. The verification results indicate that transmission rate of video and audio communications is uniform, images and sound are clear without jamming, no packet loss is occurred. Thus the proposed network is suitable for the communications between low-orbit manned spacecraft and ground station, and can be used as a reference for manned moon landing and manned Mars landing.

articleTitle: Dynamic Network Scheduling in TSN Networks Based on Improved Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: With the continuous upgrading of communication networks and the development of artificial intelligence technology, improving the performance of communication networks by realizing their intelligence is a widely researched direction. For example, reinforcement learning is utilized for time-sensitive network (TSN) configuration to enhance its adaptability to dynamic environments. However, the training of DRL algorithms suffers from a time-consuming problem, which runs counter to the delay sensitivity of communication networks. Therefore, we utilize network prediction algorithms to assist reinforcement learning by proposing an improved DRL algorithm, called preDQN, which will be used to help agents explore the environment more efficiently and reduce the time they spend in the training process compared to the agent's blind exploration behavior in the DRL algorithm. Experimental validation has been carried out in a simulation environment and the experimental results show that the improved reinforcement learning algorithm preDQN can significantly improve its convergence.

articleTitle: Investigation on Indoor Positioning by Improved RTT-RSS Fusion Ranging Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: With the development of wireless sensor network (WSN) technology, WSN based indoor localization technology has received more and more attention. Wi-Fi based ranging methods has become a current research hotspot in the field of localization due to their low cost and low complexity. However, the use of Wi-Fi based ranging methods is subject to large errors due to noise and multipath effects. To address this challenge, in this paper, the indoor positioning of RTT-RSS fusion is investigated by the improved ranging method. Firstly, the logarithmic attenuation model based on RSSI is improved by quadratic polynomial and the RTT is calibrated by linear model. And then the adaptive weighting method is adopted to fuse the RTT and RSS. Finally, the positions of the target nodes are obtained by the trilateral localization method. In the experimental results, the complex environment of indoor localization is simulated in the corridor and lounge respectively. And the results show that the method proposed in this paper can effectively improve the localization accuracy compared with the traditional method.

articleTitle: An AIOT-based Health Monitoring System Integrating Contact and Non-contact Detections
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Aiming at the deficiency of the contact health detection devices, this paper proposes a new health detection system based on millimeter wave radar, which combines noncontact and contact mechanism. In addition to collecting vital signs such as human breathing and heartbeat, the system also collects key information such as human movement, blood oxygen and body temperature through deploying various IoT (Internet of Things) node devices. Specific implementation is based on 4G/WIFI/Bluetooth communication modules by using MQTT protocol to remotely transmit the collected data to the IoT platform and client APPs. Furthermore, the cloud platform stores and analyzes the data, ensures the stability of data storage, and draws real-time curves to make the physical condition of the test subject more intuitive. Experimental results have proven that the presented system has good stability, wide application range and high application prospect, especially for the life monitoring of the elderly living alone.

articleTitle: IoT Edge Network Design Through 3D Massive MIMO
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: In this paper, the connectivity of Internet of Things (IoT) network via 3D massive MIMO technology has been analysed. We have deployed a single-cell to create connectivity for a considerable IoT users. Comprehensive channel model has been driven in the elevation domain as well as in the azimuthal domain. Additionally, We have calculated bandwidth efficiency (BE) equations for zero-forcing (ZF), and the proposed scheme named as improved zero-forcing (IZF) in IoT network having connectivity through 3D massive MIMO. The proposed scheme has been tested through various important parameters such as single-to-noise (SNR) and changing the angular spread. Additionally, we have also checked the values of BE with different number of IoT users. The comprehensive analysis has been performed through multiple antenna configurations. The simulations indicate that, our proposed IZF outperforms traditional ZF in terms of BE while varying several parameters. Furthermore, we implicate that the 3D massive MIMO technology can be applied freely for connecting an IoT edge networks.

Author Keywords: internet of things edge network (IoT) improved zero-forcing (IZF) precoding

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Performance Analysis of a Novel Variable Thickness Airborne Radome
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of the distortion of the pattern, wave transmission rate degradation, excessive aiming error and cross-polarization level lift when electromagnetic wave passed through the dielectric radome, a novel airborne radome based on variable thickness design was proposed. Firstly, the overall structure of the antenna-radome system is determined, and after analyzing the incident angle of electromagnetic waves through the radome, the optimization method of variable thickness design is adopted to reduce the incident phase difference and improve the transmission efficiency of electromagnetic waves, and finally the performance parameters of the variable thickness radome are analyzed by 3-D ray-tracing method (combined with the aperture integration method). The simulation results show that the transmittance is more than 90% in the 7-13GHz range, and the effect of radome on antenna pattern, VSWR and cross-polarization level lift can be significantly reduced by the variable thickness design of radome core layer.

articleTitle: Decentralized Blockchain Framework for Efficient and Secure VNF Development
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: This paper tackles the challenges associated with large-scale network service development in Network Functions Virtualization (NFV). We first propose a comprehensive blockchain-based framework covering the Virtualized Network Function (VNF) development stage. Then, we introduce a credit value-based evaluation model, encompassing direct and indirect evaluation, to assess contractors' creditworthiness dynamically. Correspondingly, we design a credit evaluation algorithm for practical implementation. Meanwhile, we formulate the VNF development schedule risk as a two-layer distributed decision model and introduce a two-layer continuous domain ant colony optimization (TCACO). Furthermore, we introduce a trusted repository to establish a secure VNF delivery platform, providing integrity checks for VNF packages through blockchain. Extensive simulation experiments using ONAP and Ethereum confirm the effectiveness of the proposed mechanism. This paper contributes a comprehensive framework for managing VNF development risks and enhancing efficiency in the management of large-scale network function services.

articleTitle: Efficient Networking Architecture for Fiber Optic Network Timing Service in New Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: In the context of the construction of new power systems, the transmission network is related to the reliability and quality of the entire power grid, the economy and safety of power system operation, and the daily life of the people and the development of the national economy. High precision time synchronization is a strong guarantee for the safe and stable operation of distribution systems. The time-frequency synchronization technology based on fiber optic transmission has the advantages of high accuracy, high stability, and low loss. In recent years, fiber optic time-frequency synchronization technology has developed rapidly, with new methods, technologies, and applications constantly emerging. This article studies the problem of setting the main clock position reasonably and proposes a PTP domain division algorithm in fiber optic networks. Simulation results show that this algorithm can improve the time synchronization accuracy of clock nodes.

articleTitle: Chaotic Encryption Scheme Based on Polar Coding in Fiber Optic Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: In this paper, a time-frequency domain chaotic encryption algorithm based on polar code is proposed. A logistic chaotic mapping is used to generate chaotic sequences for bit-level encryption inside polar coding, while the Rossler model is used to achieve displacement masking and spatial masking of constellations, which improves the security in the transmission process of fiber optic communication systems. The scheme implements a key space of size 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">183</sup>. Both theoretical analysis and simulation results show that the algorithm has high security with nearly zero BER and performance loss.

articleTitle: Design of Emergency Rescue Satellite Communication System Based on High-Throughput Satellite
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Natural disasters occur frequently due to the vast territory of China, and communication challenges during rescue and relief operations have always been a bottleneck that hinders efficiency. Specifically, during the 2008 Wenchuan earthquake emergency relief efforts, the most heavily impacted areas were without means of communication for over 72 hours, severely impeding the analysis and evaluation of the relief situation and significantly disrupting the relief process. Currently, integrating various forms of data such as drones, audio and video equipment are essential for accurately assessing the situation in disaster areas and improving the effectiveness of rescue operations. Real-time transmission of this data to the front command headquarters and command center allows for scientific and precise development of disaster relief strategies. At present, ground mobile communications are severely impaired by natural disasters such as earthquakes, floods, and typhoons. Communication facilities become heavily damaged and rendered useless during such events. Satellite communication is not limited by space, time, geography, or power, among other conditions and facilities. High-throughput satellites employ technological advantages such as high power, multipoint beams, and frequency multiplexing, enabling them to offer high-speed, large-bandwidth, multi-user communication services for emergency disaster relief. Based on an analysis of the technical features of high throughput satellites, this paper proposes a three-tiered emergency satellite communication system consisting of an emergency detachment, front command headquarters, and command center. Additionally, this paper outlines technical specifications and requirements for satellite communication terminals, wireless area coverage, and secure transmission. The findings of this study provide valuable insights and serve as a useful reference for developing China's emergency rescue satellite communication system.

articleTitle: Study on Single Particle Scattering Characteristics of OAM Light Based on Finite-Difference Time-Domain Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Orbital angular momentum light greatly increases its ability to transmit information due to the helical phase it carries. Light is affected by many factors during its propagation, and particle scattering is one of them. Scattering will cause the change of light intensity and phase. The effect of particle parameters on scattering can be obtained by analyzing the result of OAM light scattering by particles. In this paper, the single particle scattering characteristics of OAM light are studied by using finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) method. The scattering characteristics are represented by light intensity and phase images, and the light scattering information of different particle parameters is obtained, where the influence of particle parameters on the light scattering characteristics of OAM beam can be found.

articleTitle: Data Interaction Standardization Technology between Multi-terminal and Main Station System on Distributed Power Station
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: With the massive access of distributed power sources, multi-terminals on the station side need to exchange data with different business systems of the main station. By converting the transmitted data into an intermediate data format based on JSON, the data from different data sources can be safely transmitted to the dispatching side, which greatly improves the security and convenience of data interaction between the station side and the main station side, and avoids the need for R&D personnel to write similar codes for different data sources to achieve data interaction. The interface is used by developers, which reduces the amount of development code, improves development efficiency, and saves costs.

articleTitle: Load Balancing Algorithm for SDN Multi-Controller with Elite Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: In Software Defined Networking (SDN), the distributed deployment of multiple controllers improves the scalability and reliability of the network control plane. However, there is an issue of load imbalance in multi-controller deployments. By modeling the SDN controller load balancing problem, it is transformed into a switch migration strategy selection problem, and a multi-objective optimization model is constructed with the average transmission delay, load balancing degree and migration cost of controller cluster as optimization objectives. In this paper, an Elite Genetic Algorithm (EGAI) Improvement is proposed to solve the model. The convergence speed and stability of the algorithm are improved by introducing self-identification crossover operator and elite retention strategy. Simulation results show that this algorithm can optimize the mapping relationship between controller and switch, and optimize the performance of the network.

articleTitle: Analysis of Underwater Optical Transfer of Radio-Frequency Signal in Turbulence Water Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Water flow and temperature drift are the main sources of underwater turbulence. In laser based underwater frequency transfer, underwater turbulence will introduce timing fluctuations, leading to deterioration of frequency transfer. In order to reveal the relationship between the timing fluctuation of transferred frequency signal and the drift of velocity and temperature, this paper establishes a mathematical model to analyze the timing fluctuation caused by water flow and temperature under different gradients. To validate our model, we transmitted a 100 MHz RF signal on a 3.5-meter underwater transmission link, with different artificial flow velocity and temperature drift set during the transmission process. The measured timing fluctuations are consistent with our analysis. The experimental results show that within 5000s, the root mean square (RMS) timing fluctuations of RF signals with velocity gradient, temperature gradient, and no gradient are approximately 37 ps, 123 ps, and 23 ps, respectively. This indicates that the timing fluctuation caused by temperature gradient is higher than that caused by velocity gradient.

articleTitle: A Novel Method for Mapping Parallel Vector-Scalar Multiplication on CGRA
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: In this study, a novel method for mapping parallel vector-scalar multiplication on a specific Coarse Gained Reconfigurable Arrays (CGRA) is proposed for a research of the scalable Chiplet-based design. The method has been implemented for an example with a 7x7 matrix non-pivot LU decomposition, which practically applied in signal processing in 5G wireless systems. The iteration cost has been improved comparing with the direct-mapping method.

articleTitle: Survey of the Application of Privacy Computing Technology in the Electric-power Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: With the advent of the Internet and big data era, the value of data is becoming increasingly significant and plays an increasingly important role in various fields. However, it also brings various problems, including data privacy and security. The power industry has collected and stored massive amounts of electricity data. It is particularly urgent to solve the contradiction between the security privacy protection and data sharing of these power big data, and realize the goal that the original data will not be exported, but the data "value" and "knowledge" will be exported. This paper sort out the application of privacy computing technology in the power industry through domestic and foreign literature surveys. This paper analyzes in detail how Secure multi-party computation, Federated learning, Trusted execution environment and other privacy computing technologies can solve the problem of sensitive data and privacy data protection in data sharing in the power industry. On this basis, a privacy protection framework suitable for the power industry based on privacy computing technology is proposed. Then, the impact of privacy computing technology on the power industry was summarized, as well as some challenges that may be encountered during implementation. At the end of the article, potential research directions and technological applications were pointed out, hoping to promote the development of privacy protection in the power industry.

articleTitle: Local-Field to Global-Field Transformation for Metamaterial-Inspired Antennas (Metantennas)
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: In energy transport theorem (ETT)-based decoupling mode theory (DMT), the diagonalizing input power operator (IPO) method was used to calculate the energy-decoupled modes (DMs) of antennas. Taking metamaterial-inspired antenna (metantenna) as a typical example, this paper proposes a method for modifying the original IPO, and also provides a DMs-based application—local-field to global-field transformation. Compared with the original IPO, the modified IPO has a more satisfactory numerical performance. The DMs-based local-field to global-field transformation method uses the DMs-based modal expansion to realize the determination for the global field from the field value on a local sampling surface. The sampling surface can either closed or open; when the sampling surface is closed, it can either enclose the metantenna or not. In fact, the DMs-based local-field to global-field transformation method can be viewed as a generalization for the conventional multipoles-based far-field to near-field transformation method.

articleTitle: Review of Research Progress on Human Fall Detection Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: As an important means of ensuring human safety, fall detection technology can be widely applied in various fields such as elderly care, medical treatment, sports training and rehabilitation, industrial safety, etc., aiming to timely identify the risk of falls and take corresponding rescue measures to reduce the damage caused by falls to the human body. This article first briefly introduces the basic situation of human fall detection technology; According to the different implementation methods of the system, it is divided into wearable device based, environmental sensor based, and computer vision based fall detection. Then, each type of detection technology and system principle is analyzed, and the research progress in recent years is summarized; Finally, an overview of evaluation indicators and classic datasets was provided, and research on fall detection was summarized and prospected.

articleTitle: Multi-Source Heterogeneous Alarm Fusion Method for Intelligent Measuring System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: The alarm information generated by security equipment in intelligent measuring system is characterized by isolation, fragmentation and redundancy, which makes it difficult for security personnel to carry out security analysis and corresponding defense work. Therefore, a multi-source heterogeneous alarm fusion method for intelligent measuring system is proposed in this paper, which aims to associate and simplify the complicated and redundant alarm information of intelligent measuring system and reduce the difficulty of alarm information processing. In this paper, a multi-source heterogeneous alarm fusion framework is designed to fuse alarm information generated by different security equipment in intelligent measuring system based on the exponential weighted D-S evidence theory synthesis rules. The proposed method can reduce the total number of alarms in intelligent measuring system, reduce the complexity of alarm information, and effectively solve the problem of false alarm and missing alarm.

articleTitle: Fault Detection in Analog/Digtal VLSI Circuits based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Due to the explosive demand and rapid development of the electronics industry, the integration and complexity of electronic devices have significantly grown. Fault detection has played a vital role in identification of faults in electronic circuits, ensuring normal operation and reliability of systems. Given traditional methods of fault detection are often inaccurate and time-consuming, artificial intelligence techniques are a growing interest for researchers of this field. In this paper, various artificial intelligence-based fault detection techniques in analog and digital VLSI circuits are described. In addition, two distinct models for fault detection of digital circuits based on deep learning are proposed. The primary goal of the first approach is utilization of a stacked sparse autoencoder to avoid the search space explosion problem. The second proposed method utilizes an optimization method for detecting the best model configuration. The proposed models deliver maximum validation accuracy of 97.7% and 95.7% respectively, implemented on digital circuit from ISCAS’85.

articleTitle: A Novel Semantic Global Descriptor for 3D Point Cloud Place Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Place recognition provides global pose constraints to Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) systems to eliminate cumulative errors over time. Semantic-driven LiDAR-based methods have been in great graces due to its accurate range information, strong illumination invariance and descriptive semantic information. However, the performance improvement has encountered bottlenecks due to inaccurate pose estimation and lack of encoding function with strong representation ability. To tackle these issues, a novel semantic-driven LiDAR-based global descriptor is proposed in this paper. A two-step global Generalized semantic iterative closest points (GSICP) algorithm is proposed to estimate accurate relative pose transformation to align point clouds. After achieving invariance of pose, point clouds are divided into bins. Subsequently an effective encoding function which can aggregate information of each bin and its neighborhood is designed to construct the descriptor. Whether the loop closure occurs is determined by the similarity score of descriptors. Detailed experiments constructed on the KITTI odometry dataset demonstrate the outperformed performance of proposed method.

Index Terms: Root Mean Square Error Of Cross-validation

articleTitle: Image Prediction of Alzheimer's Disease Based on Efficient Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronics and Communication Engineering (ICECE)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a neurodegenerative disease that usually starts slowly and progressively worsens. As of 2020, there were approximately 50 million people worldwide with Alzheimer's disease. It affects about 6% of people 65 years and older. Traditional detection methods are complex, expensive, and less accurate. In this study, an Alzheimer's phase detection method based on improved convolution neural network fine-tuning was proposed to diagnose the severity of Alzheimer's disease. The method was trained and classified on Alzheimer's Dataset (4 class of Images), which classified the patient condition into four stages. The model has a High accuracy and can help doctors to identify the patient's state. The advantages of this model are that it has a simple structure and high accuracy, which can quickly make a high-confidence classification judgment on the input image, and can be applied to clinical treatment.
